Beware, Commander: the battlefield has descended into madness. 

Step into Steel Asylum, the latest season of World of Tanks Modern Armor, and face 100 Stages packed with rewards worthy of those brave enough to confront the unknown. Earn Gold, War Chests, Premium Account time, Premium tanks, and more as you fight your way through a season where fear lurks around every corner. 

Unlock the Season Pass and make your escape with the VCC-80/60, an Escalation Era Light Tank built to strike from the shadows and keep enemies guessing. Looking for an even greater advantage? The Ultimate Season Pass immediately grants you the Serpente — a deadly Tier IX medium tank ready to spread panic across the battlefield — and Desmond "Doc" Rose, a 3D Hero Commander whose unsettling expertise may be exactly what you need to survive the chaos ahead. 

But the horrors of Steel Asylum are only beginning. Prepare for chilling Halloween festivities, incredible
